Answer: C
Reason: The CT images demonstrate a mosaic attenuation pattern with areas of hyperlucency (air trapping) and increased density, which is a hallmark radiological finding of bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD). This chronic lung disease typically affects infants born prematurely who required prolonged oxygen therapy or mechanical ventilation, matching the clinical history described in option C.
